# ADR-3079: A07: Knowledge-based auth questions for recovery 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

KBA answers are often public or reused.

## Decision

Recovery MUST NOT rely on knowledge-based auth questions for recovery 7 (A07-7) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Out-of-band verified channels replace KBA.
